items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Somebody, I think Houston used to do most of the arranging for him at that time... Which Houston is that? The one that played the piano, William Houston.

ctx.x: He got a lot of work and everything?

Yeah, he was popular. Yeah, he was working. They would, they was playing all those top tunes. Somebody, I think Houston used to do most of the arranging for him at that time. He used to play the piano. Which Houston is that? The one that played the piano, William Houston.
